name: imgconverter
description: Convert Markdown images to HTML img tags with one click.

scripts.test: npm run typecheck && node scripts/bundle.mjs && mkdir -p coverage && node --test --experimental-test-coverage --test-coverage-include=src/js/convert-to-img-tag.js --test-coverage-include=src/js/options.js --test-reporter=spec --test-reporter=lcov --test-reporter-destination=stdout --test-reporter-destination=coverage/lcov.info spec/js/*.test.js spec/pure/.out/*.test.js && playwright test
scripts.debug_test: npm run typecheck && node scripts/bundle.mjs && playwright test --headed
scripts.package: npm run typecheck && node scripts/bundle.mjs && node scripts/package.mjs

author: funzin
